answer: An adversary as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The onyx counter is kept in anchor and orchard shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
